featured_reviews.name: Drashti Maniyar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I wish I visited this place sooner. Honestly, one of the best cafes I have been to. The food is just top notch.
We had-
1. Hazelnut Chocolate Shake- perfectly made using dark chocolate. Great taste of hazelnuts as well.
2. Cheesecake smoothie- felt like a blueberry cheesecake but in a glass. So good!
3. Cottage Cheese Chimichurri Crepe- HIGHLY HIGHLY RECOMMENDED! The best dish I have had lately. It is very filling. The crepe was stuffed with vegetables in a green gravy along with paneer. Poured a nice cheese sauce over it. Quantity was good enough for 2.
4. Roast bell pepper pasta with onions, sundried tomatoes and cream cheese- The taste was spot on. Cream cheese added a nice taste. You will definitely lick your fingers after this one.
5. Hummus platter- Hummus was very smooth, served with bread, lavash, ragi crackers and salad. Hummus could be lil more garlicky and pita bread instead of normal bread would be ideal. Nevertheless, it was decent.
6. Baked lemon cheesecake- This was on my list for so long. The lemon cream had a nice zing and hit all the right notes. Please please try it out.
If you are looking to try something new and unique, this one is for you.

Long Overdue Take.
As a frequent local visitor, writing this review for Cafe Cypress has been long overdue. After a year of making it my usual spot for dinner or a quick bite—it's right next to home—I can confidently say this place is a gem in Mulund West. The atmosphere is fantastic—cozy, casual, and refined, making it perfect for any occasion.

The menu is extensive, but everything is consistently great. Their Pizza is a standout, and for brunch, the Mediterranean Omelette or the Nutella Peanut Butter Toast are top-notch.

The service is attentive, but here's a Visitor Tip: Give the chef some time, everything is made fresh. Order an appetizer for the meanwhile so you don't get grumpy while you wait!

My Top Favorites (Tried and Loved):
I've been through a lot of the menu, and my top recommendations are:
Sizzlers, Grilled Chicken Burger, French Fries, Pasta, Fried Rice, Prawns Butter Garlic, Chicken Butter Garlic, Saute Veggies (Customizable to taste), Tiramisu, Chocolate Moose, Hummus and Pita Bread, My Repeat Order: Cheese Omelette Sandwich (Every visit!)
Final Verdict: Cafe Cypress delivers exceptional food, a welcoming ambiance, and great value. Highly recommended for anyone in the area!

Shameful & Disturbing Incident Outside Mani’s, Mulund (18th Oct 2025)
This review isn’t about food — it’s about basic humanity, which I saw completely missing outside Mani’s, Mulund West on the evening of 18th October 2025 (Saturday) during Diwali time.
While I was having dosa with my family, I witnessed something horrifying — a tall man in a kurta slapped and dragged a young beggar girl right outside the café. She must have been barely 10–12 years old. He hit her so hard, then grabbed her by her t-shirt and pulled her, while everyone just stood there and watched. It was one of the most disgusting things I’ve ever seen.
And what shocked me most — not one single person from Mani’s staff or management came forward. No one tried to stop that man or even check on that child. Everyone simply ignored it as if nothing happened. Even after assaulting her, that man came back to collect his parcel calmly while his wife sat in the car watching!
I want to ask Mani’s management — do your CCTV cameras not work? Did no staff member see this? Why didn’t anyone step up? It happened right at your doorstep. If you claim to be a family-friendly place, you also have a moral responsibility to protect people outside your premises, especially a child being assaulted in public view.
That moment made me lose all respect for this place. Good food means nothing when basic humanity and courage are missing. I truly hope Mani’s management takes this seriously, checks their CCTV footage from 18th October, identifies that man, and at least reports this inhuman act. Silence in such situations is shameful.
